blind.description: A weathered stone statue of a seated figure wearing robes and a tall cylindrical headdress/crown, seated cross-legged on a blocky stone throne or plinth. In its lap it holds a large round stone bowl or basin. The figure's left hand is broken off at the wrist, giving it an ancient, ruined appearance. The texture is rough brownish-grey stone with green moss accents across the shoulders, headdress, and base. Surfaces are solid and continuous, sitting firmly flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it shows the circular rim of the hollow top of the headdress, broad shoulders, a large round stone bowl held between the thighs, and the rectangular outline of the stone seat beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet wide.
